entries.text: Shop opened with six printable models across four lines: two desk organizers, a print-in-place fidget, two decor pieces and a four-part multi-colour whale.
Every file is checked before it is listed: closed surfaces, one shell per part, size and volume recorded. Six of six passed with zero open edges.
Payments are not connected yet. Buy and membership buttons walk through the checkout in demo mode, and free models download for real.
Next drop is scheduled for tomorrow at 09:00 (Vietnam time). The rotation runs functional, print-in-place, decor, then figure, so every line gets a new model each week.
